followedSwap: That is in the {tree} tree, so the matching folder in the library is used
keysMarks: Red, yellow, green and blue colour labels, as Lightroom has them
appearanceTip: Appearance: light or dark, theme and colour
noticeOpen: Opens it. This line goes when you do.
automationOff: Automation is off, so nothing runs by itself.
automationByDsm: {n} {n:flow is|flows are} run by DSM's Task Scheduler instead.
quitBody: The page stops working until you start it again from the Start menu. Anything running stops half way and is left where it is. History says what it managed.
pinnedTip: On the main list. Press to take it off.
foldersNoneYet: none yet: add the folders to work on
fullOn: Showing the files themselves for every photo from here on. Scroll or pinch to get close enough to see the difference.
fullOff: Showing previews again: faster, and enough to sort by
fullShownTip: The file itself is on screen. Press for the quick preview.
notPlayable: No browser plays {ext} videos: it is a camera format, not a web one. The file is untouched. Download opens it in a player, or Separate video moves it to your video tree.
unlocateBody: It comes off this photo, its RAW file and its preview, and out of the sidecar beside them. Geotag can put one back from your timeline afterwards.
deletedWithOthers: Deleted with {n} other {n:file|files}, into the Recycle Bin
notAnswering: The app is not answering and may have stopped. Still trying. Start it again if this does not clear.
planHeadings: {n} {n:heading|headings}. Click one to see the files under it.
flowDsmTip: This app never runs this flow. DSM's Task Scheduler does, on whatever schedule you gave it there.
needsHttps: A phone allows this only on a secure (https) address. The README says how to get one.
copyTip: Copies them into a folder you choose. The originals stay here.
moveTip: Moves them into a folder you choose. They leave this folder.
recycleTip: Moves them to the share's Recycle Bin, where you can put them back.
copyRefused: Could not copy: the browser refused
treeLibrary: your photos, the tree everything else follows
treeRaw: the RAW files, in a tree shaped like the library
treeVideo: videos, kept apart from the photos
rnChanged: {n} {n:name|names} changed in the table. Nothing is written yet.
rnNoNames: The pattern could not name any of those: no dated photos in them
rnBad: {n} {n:row|rows} cannot be renamed. The table says why.
rnBodyEnd: . Nothing is written over: a name already taken is refused.
rnTicked: Every tool above works on the {n} ticked {n:row|rows} only.
rnNothing: Nothing changed yet. Type over a name.
rnSome: {changed} changed, {bad} cannot be renamed. Fix those first.
arrangeTip: Drag is not needed: use the arrows. Every change saves as you make it.
bandsKept: Kept. The charts use these now.
homeResetBody: The dashboard itself is untouched. Only this arrangement of it goes.
moreValues: and {n} more. Type part of a name.
filledIn: Filled in. Press Check the list.
searchesNone: none yet: fill the boxes below and keep it
nextFailed: Every failure above is grouped by its cause. Fix the cause and press Check again. What already worked is not done twice.
nextCancelled: It stopped where you told it to. Check again picks up from what is left.
nextSkipped: What it left alone, and why, is listed above. Read it when a photo you expected to move did not.
stillReading: {done} of {total} so far. Everything appears as it is found, so nothing is waiting on you.
selSortTip: Moves the files into folders by the date they were taken, as a list you check first.
selDevelopTip: Copies these out to the develop tree for editing. The originals stay.
selToolsTip: Everything else that works on a set of photos.
selMoreTip: The file-level actions, and the ones that cannot be taken back.
selRateTip: Put stars or a colour label on the selected photos. Written into the files.
fromSelection: From your selection: {n} {n:photo|photos} in {folders} {folders:folder|folders}. This tool works on whole folders, so check the list before you apply.
albumForgetMine: The photos are not touched. Only the album goes, and nothing else holds it.
albumForget: The photos are not touched. Only the album goes.
albumNoCriteria: Nothing set yet. An album with no criteria would be every photo you have.
albumEmpty: . None does, so the album would be empty
albumNeedsOne: Set at least one criterion, or it is every photo
nothingNarrowed: Nothing is narrowed down yet. Set a filter first.
groupRemoveTip: Remove the group. Its tools go back to the group they came with.
arrangeSaved: Saved. The rail and the tools follow it now.
keysFit: Fit the whole photo on the screen again
keysPanel: The details panel beside the photo
noPreview: No preview can be made of this file.
cannotPlayType: This browser cannot play {ext} videos. The file is untouched. Download opens it in a player, or try Chrome, Edge or Safari, which can.
couldNotPlay: This browser could not play that video. The file is untouched, and Download opens it in a player that can.
videoNoExposure: A video has no single exposure to read
applyNote: Applying does exactly what is listed above: this list, not a fresh one.
patternReading: Reading the photos in those folders...
patternNote: Read from the photos inside each folder. A folder with no dated photo keeps its name.
bandsNote: Nothing is written to a photo. These only decide how the counting is grouped, so no change here can lose anything.
flowsNote: Nothing here touches a photo. Saving writes the flows file, and the Automation tab is where one is run.
nothingUntilApply: Nothing is written until you apply.
noLibrary: Tell the app where your photos are, or build a sample library to try everything out on photos that are not yours.
noLocationYet: No photo in the library carries a location yet. Geotag can put them on.
folderEmpty: No photos sit directly in here.
placesHint: Drag to move, scroll or use + and − to zoom. Press a pin to see the photos taken there.
placesNone: A photo knows where it was taken only if the camera wrote it in. Geotag works it out from your Google Timeline, and Pin a place puts one on a whole folder by hand.
albumUnset: Nothing set yet. An album with no criteria would be every photo you have.
viewerNoLocation: This photo carries no location. Geotag can write one from your timeline, and Pin a place can do a whole folder by hand.
viewerFilesNote: Found by position in the mirrored trees, the same way every tool here finds them.
viewerHistory: What has been done to this photo is in History, which records every run.
peopleSub: The names written into your photos as tags. Select photos and press Tag to put a name on them.
peopleNone: Nothing in the library carries a tag that looks like a person's name. There is no face detection here. A name is one you put on, and it goes into the photo itself, so Lightroom and Synology Photos see it too.
peopleCandidates: tags in your library. Nothing is written to a photo. This only decides what appears above.
boardNote: Counted from the index {at}. Nothing was opened, so previews, separated RAW files and what has been moved aside are left blank here. The Library tab reads all five trees and fills them in.
deeperTip: Show every photo below this folder, not only the ones in it
useFolderTip: Tools that work on a folder
spanTip: What the photos in here span
sideLabel: The other tools in this group
sideOpenGroup: Open this group on All tools
